decisions.quote: This study replicates and extends the meta-analyses on family firm performance by O'Boyle et al. (2012). Based on the empirical findings of 1095 primary studies from 61 countries, we find an economically small but statistically significant positive impact of family influence on firms’ financial performance.
decisions.reason: The paper explicitly re-tests the specific previously published meta-analysis by O'Boyle et al. (2012) using a new sample of 1095 primary studies, satisfying the codebook definition of a replication rather than a standalone meta-analysis that re-tests no specific earlier finding.
